title: json-fn evaluation test suite
description: Documents the JSON test-suite format consumed from spec/cases/eval.

description.description: A description of the test suite.

cases.description: The evaluation cases in this suite.

description.description: A description used as the test name.

body.description: The json-fn function body to evaluate.

args.description: Arguments supplied to the function body. Defaults to an empty array.

functions.description: Module entries available only to this case, overriding suite entries with the same name.

expected.description: The expected evaluation result. Mutually exclusive with error.

error.description: A substring expected in the thrown error. Mutually exclusive with expected.

functionBody.description: A canonical json-fn function body. Additional fields remain allowed because some cases intentionally exercise runtime validation of malformed bodies.

functions.description: Named module entries forming the outermost lexical scope. An entry whose literal value is a function body is callable by name; any other entry is a module value entry, evaluated per the entry-closure rule with the case body as the selected entry.

limits.description: Deterministic execution limits applied to the case.

maxCallDepth.description: Maximum nested json-fn function invocation depth.

maxValueSize.description: Maximum produced array length or string length.

observations.description: Observed side channels compared when present, alongside expected or error.

logs.description: The exact ordered sequence of logger calls.
